zsu0hyso8k4q0b13sp14xnwt.title: Amstelpark
zsu0hyso8k4q0b13sp14xnwt.what: 10 Japanese cherries (April): 6 'Pink Perfection', 3 Yoshino cherries (Prunus yedoensis), 1 'Kanzan'
zsu0hyso8k4q0b13sp14xnwt.notes: A small group near De Borcht, planted between 1970 and 2007. 'Pink Perfection' has clear pink flowers about 3 cm across from dark pink-red buds, in April; the yedoensis open white from pink buds, faintly almond-scented, in April; the 'Kanzan' is double pink, late April to early May. Sources: vdberk.nl prunus-serrulata-pink-perfection, prunus-yedoensis, prunus-serrulata-kanzan.

zsu0hyso8k4q0b13sp14xnwt.title: Amstelpark
zsu0hyso8k4q0b13sp14xnwt.what: 35 crab apples (April to May: 20 Malus, 7 'Profusion', 4 Malus floribunda, 4 Malus toringo), 14 Prunus 'Umineko' (white, April), 17 Japanese cherries (5 yedoensis, 5 'Fugenzo' mid May, 2 'Amanogawa', 2 'Spire', 3 other)
zsu0hyso8k4q0b13sp14xnwt.notes: Crab apples in the south of the park (52.326561, 4.894046), planted 1970 to 1984; floribunda and toringo have dark pink buds opening light pink, fading white. 'Umineko' group (52.333381, 4.89328), all planted 1998. Mixed cherries (52.330546, 4.894955), planted 1970 to 2007: yedoensis early April through to 'Fugenzo' in mid May.

ixmzhd415cly8a0avk7utsdo.title: Nelson Mandelapark and Kwaku
ixmzhd415cly8a0avk7utsdo.what: 48 Japanese cherries 'Ichiyo' (mid April to mid May), 30 magnolias (March to May)
ixmzhd415cly8a0avk7utsdo.notes: 48 'Ichiyo', planted 2014 to 2021, along the Reigersbospad and Hogevechtpad: broad flat crowns, double pale pink flowers from mid April to mid May. 30 magnolias by the Karspeldreef and Bullewijkpad, planted 2009 to 2026: 13 'Royal Crown', 10 Magnolia kobus (white, March), 3 'Yellow Lantern' (lemon-yellow tulip-shaped flowers, May), 3 Magnolia soulangeana (April) and 1 other. Sources: vdberk.nl prunus-serrulata-ichiyo, magnolia-kobus, magnolia-yellow-lantern, magnolia-soulangeana.

r03v323omw6y207in0nj4au6.title: Rembrandtpark (western half)
r03v323omw6y207in0nj4au6.notes: A row of 24 Magnolia soulangeana along the Nachtwachtlaan at the park's west edge, planted from 2006 with replacements up to 2022; tulip-shaped white and/or pink flowers before the leaves, April into May (Van den Berk: https://www.vdberk.nl/bomen/magnolia-soulangeana/). Register: https://api.data.amsterdam.nl/v1/bomen/stamgegevens/?_format=json&gbdBuurtId=03630980000223&soortnaam=Magnolia%20soulangeana

xvwlcc589nw0oij8h1yc2xn9.title: Dwaze Moedersplein
xvwlcc589nw0oij8h1yc2xn9.what: 37 crab apples: 35 Malus 'Evereste' (May), 1 Malus floribunda (April), 1 Malus toringo (April)
xvwlcc589nw0oij8h1yc2xn9.notes: The square itself is planted with crab apples, from 1986 (the year the memorial stone was unveiled) with replacements up to 2026. 'Evereste': dark purple-pink buds opening pure white, flowers almost 6 cm, in May; orange-red to red apples up to 2.5 cm that hang on far into winter (https://www.vdberk.nl/bomen/malus-evereste/). Not a green-pool place, but an existing pool place on the exact spot, so no duplicate. Register: https://api.data.amsterdam.nl/v1/bomen/stamgegevens/?_format=json&gbdBuurtId=03630980000214&soortnaam=Malus%20%27Evereste%27

yw4m202pvcw809m5oo6tvvjy.title: Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark
yw4m202pvcw809m5oo6tvvjy.notes: Western part of the park along the Hunneschans and Buitenveldertselaan: 206 white wild hawthorn Crataegus monogyna plus 7 'Splendens', 2 lavalleei, all planted 1966 to 1991 (the Hunneschans row alone 183). Cornelian cherry Cornus mas, yellow flowers in February before the leaves, red fruits in early autumn: 24 by the Hunneschans/Buitenveldertselaan (1966 to 1975) and a row of 30 on the Enzerinck side by the middle part (12 + 18, all 1966). Overpass confirms r001 and the r113 groups inside the park outline; r078 and r156 adjoin them.

qd0m975el7mdfp3aysy59gps.title: Vondelpark
qd0m975el7mdfp3aysy59gps.notes: Eastern part (Vondelpark-Oost, near the Vondelstraat side, around 52.3596, 4.8713): 67 double white Aesculus hippocastanum 'Baumannii' (sterile, no conkers, longer flowering than the species), 10 ordinary horse chestnuts, 2 other, planted 1942 to 2014. Western end (around 52.3571, 4.8622): 20 white wild hawthorn Crataegus monogyna and 1 'Paul's Scarlet', 1965 to 2003.

esioyoe9ueen62my3l2cdxo1.title: Erasmuspark
esioyoe9ueen62my3l2cdxo1.notes: Two new rows of Prunus × yedoensis, 28 and 26, all planted 2025, on the west side of the park (around 52.3744, 4.8511 and 52.3748, 4.8500). Pink in bud, white when open, abundant in April. Young trees, so the show will grow.

avsibstf1yq82keotdr79uwm.title: The Miracle Garden
avsibstf1yq82keotdr79uwm.notes: 17 Malus toringo and 1 Malus trilobata by the Jan van Galenstraat (around 52.3747, 4.8530, i.e. at The Miracle Garden pin), planted 1991 to 2026. Toringo: purple-red buds, light pink flowers fading white, yellow-orange fruits. Could equally go in the Erasmuspark entry if the garden boundary does not include them.

zedpvi5346iua7hv47xitlgv.title: Stadsboerderij Zimmerhoeve (Landje van Ome Kick)
zedpvi5346iua7hv47xitlgv.notes: 12 Prunus cerasifera 'Nigra' in the Schimmelstraat right by the farm (27 m from its pin), planted 1990 to 2025: single pink flowers from late March into April, as the dark purple leaves come out.

akzx2lcqjzqw8sxum6qcavfl.title: Museumplein
akzx2lcqjzqw8sxum6qcavfl.what: 102 Japanese cherries: 54 Prunus yedoensis (white, April), 36 'Kanzan' (double pink, late April to early May), 12 Prunus ×gondouinii 'Schnee' (pure white, late April to early May)
akzx2lcqjzqw8sxum6qcavfl.notes: Along the Museumpromenade, group centre 52.357513, 4.880901; planted 1996 to 2026. Yedoensis first, then 'Schnee' and 'Kanzan' together: about four weeks of blossom.

vxk4tfmr0lq9hw05ppszm99o.title: Beatrixpark
vxk4tfmr0lq9hw05ppszm99o.what: 53 horse chestnuts (May): 35 yellow buckeye Aesculus flava 'Vestita', 11 Aesculus hippocastanum, 6 double white 'Baumannii', 1 red buckeye Aesculus pavia 'Atrosanguinea'
vxk4tfmr0lq9hw05ppszm99o.notes: Near the Diepenbrockstraat side of the park, group centre 52.343711, 4.882268; planted 1938 to 2022. The yellow-flowered 'Vestita' (VdB: pale yellow flowers with a pink glow for A. flava) is the unusual one here.

pjz6wbejfbc7mb01wbtrucmo.title: Sarphatipark and the Sarphati monument
pjz6wbejfbc7mb01wbtrucmo.what: 49 horse chestnuts (May): 35 Aesculus hippocastanum, 4 'Plantierensis' (pale yellow fading to flesh pink, no conkers), 3 'Pyramidalis', 7 other
pjz6wbejfbc7mb01wbtrucmo.notes: Throughout the park, group centre 52.35442, 4.895397; planted 1926 to 2021.

vg0z6rjngmso1otuczhltuth.title: Frankendael
vg0z6rjngmso1otuczhltuth.what: 89 horse chestnuts (May): 72 white, 9 red, 6 yellow buckeye; 10 old-variety apples (April); 8 magnolias (March to April)
vg0z6rjngmso1otuczhltuth.notes: Horse chestnuts on the west side of the park by the Slingerlaan and the Kamerlingh Onneslaan, planted 2002 and 2005: 72 Aesculus hippocastanum (white candles, May), 9 Aesculus x carnea (red, May), 6 Aesculus flava (pale yellow with a pink glow, May), 2 young Aesculus (2020). Apples near the Middenweg, all planted 2002: 3 'Bramley's Seedling', 3 'Schone van Boskoop', 2 'James Grieve', 2 'Gravensteiner' (pink buds, white blossom in April). Magnolias by the Middenweg, mostly planted 1970: 3 kobus (March), 3 x soulangeana (April), 1 stellata (March), 1 unnamed.

cfpl1jwwcnurv2cxrr0z0ptb.title: Ringdijk and the Watergraafsmeer polder
cfpl1jwwcnurv2cxrr0z0ptb.what: 44 crab apples (May) on the Ringdijk, most planted 1968
cfpl1jwwcnurv2cxrr0z0ptb.notes: Two stretches of the Ringdijk on the Transvaalkade side. By the Eerste Ringdijkstraat: 14 Malus 'Aldenhamensis' and 7 'Professor Sprenger' (dark pink buds, strongly scented white flowers in May, orange-yellow fruit that stays until late December), all 1968, plus 2 young Malus hupehensis (2023). Further east by the Lise Meitnerpad: 19 Malus 'Eleyi' (purple young leaves, deep wine-red flowers from mid May, dark red fruit), 15 of them from 1968 to 1969, plus 1 'Aldenhamensis' and 1 hupehensis. All on grass, mostly under 6 m.

bjtlsgawp94nm7bw59v7zc2r.title: De Nieuwe Ooster
bjtlsgawp94nm7bw59v7zc2r.what: 41 'Heaven Scent' magnolias (April), 38 Japanese cherries (April to early May)
bjtlsgawp94nm7bw59v7zc2r.notes: All inside the cemetery grounds. On the Zaaiersweg side (around nos. 106 and 203): 40 Magnolia 'Heaven Scent' (narrow tulip-shaped lilac-pink flowers, deeper purple-pink at the base, April; still under 6 m) plus 1 more, and 12 cherries: 5 'Umineko' (white, April), 3 'Shirotae' (large white almond-scented flowers, end of April), 2 Prunus subhirtella 'Dahlem', 2 'Kanzan'. A young group of 15 'Kanzan' planted 2025 further south near Zaaiersweg 45. By the Middenweg corner: 10 'Sunset Boulevard' (white with a pink rim, April), planted 2008.

w4lbzyt68totp1szvnlsss9h.title: Westerpark
w4lbzyt68totp1szvnlsss9h.what: 66 tulip trees (June), 46 magnolias (March), 38 Japanese pagoda trees (July), 34 Japanese cherries (April), 19 golden rain trees (July)
w4lbzyt68totp1szvnlsss9h.notes: All on the Westergasfabriek side of the park. Tulip trees along the Gosschalklaan, planted 1990 to 2025 (green and orange tulip-shaped flowers among the leaves in June). Japanese cherries along the Brettenpad, planted 1991 to 2001: 22 Yoshino cherries (Prunus yedoensis, pink in bud, white and faintly almond-scented when open, April) and 12 Prunus sargentii (single light pink, April, before the leaves; orange-red autumn colour). Magnolia kobus (white, about 10 cm, March, before the leaves): 19 on the Gosschalklaan (2001), 14 on the Polonceau-kade (2001), 12 plus 1 other magnolia by the Pazzanistraat (1998 to 2001). Japanese pagoda trees (creamy white plumes up to 30 cm, July) on the Polonceau-kade, planted 2001 to 2026. Golden rain trees (Koelreuteria paniculata, yellow plumes in July, then bladder fruits) on the Gosschalklaan, planted 2001 to 2025. Sources: vdberk.nl liriodendron-tulipifera, prunus-yedoensis, prunus-sargentii, magnolia-kobus, styphnolobium-japonicum, koelreuteria-paniculata.
